projects.name: Himpawid
projects.headline: Air quality. Made understandable.
projects.description: A cross-platform mobile app that turns live environmental data into a clear picture of the air around you.
features: Live and forecast Air Quality Index
Color-coded pollution map and health guidance
An entire data pipeline built on real API sources

projects.name: TrackGuard
projects.headline: Software meets the physical world.
projects.description: An ESP32-CAM autonomous robot car that combines navigation, sensing, and a live view of its surroundings.
features: Infrared line-following and ultrasonic obstacle avoidance
Manual override through an infrared remote

projects.name: SmartClassSchedule
projects.headline: A little more order in student life.
projects.description: An Android app for managing classes, assignments, and exams, with timely reminders before classes begin.
features: Class schedules and tasks organized by subject
Tabbed dashboard for schedules and pending work
